title: JAVIS — Library Management Robot
description: Built a ROS 2 library management robot that integrates autonomous navigation, manipulation, and vision AI to pick up and return books and guide visitors.

title: ROOMIE — Hotel Room-Service Robot
description: Developed a controller and trajectory generator for a three-axis arm that operates elevator buttons. Completed the integrated demonstration in 38 days by separating calibration and alignment actions.

title: FALCON — Runway Safety Monitoring System
description: Custom-trained a runway hazard detection model and verified accuracy above 90%. Integrated ByteTrack-based trajectory tracking with hazard assessment logic.
